snippet.title: King Assassination - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
King Assassination:

The game takes place in a medieval kingdom where the king roams freely among his subjects. However, assassins in disguise lie in wait, attempting to kill him before he reaches his destination. Guards are tasked with protecting him and ensuring his safe passage.
The game features five assassins against five guards, each with their own unique skills. It is an online multiplayer game with no bots.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/5071940/King_Assassination
